STILLROOT'S SONG   |   PLAYER HANDOUT

Keep these places

Oren Halden: small hands, burned thumb, repaired the north window. Elsbeth takes no sugar; he always remembered.

Garrick Clover: more salt than Marnie allowed, laughed before the end of his own stories.

Ada Brindle: flour behind her left ear when she was tired.

Perrin Voss: taps a letter twice before sealing it.

Sella Venn: leaves three diagonal stitches where others leave two.

Corven Flint: listens to the hammer after he has put it down.

I have checked the chairs again. The number of people has changed. The number of places they wore into this house has not.

If I forget, please tell me something they did. A name may slide away. A kindness catches.
